subject.title: Plugin `message_sending` hooks silently bypassed on channel agent-reply delivery paths (2026.5.26, still present in 2026.6.1)

question: Which open fix branch should be canonical for the `message_sending` configured-beforeDeliver and Telegram streamed-final bypass?
rationale: Current main and the latest release still reproduce the source-level bug, but the open PRs differ on scope, readiness, and exactly-once hook ownership, so automation should not queue another competing fix before maintainers choose the branch direction.

options.title: Select comprehensive branch after repair
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93216 as the canonical path if maintainers accept its exactly-once ownership shape and the draft/conflict/proof state is resolved.

options.title: Land a narrow dispatcher fix first
options.body: Use a smaller dispatcher-only candidate such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92976 while keeping Telegram streamed-final coverage tracked separately.

options.title: Ask for a replacement branch
options.body: Close or supersede the current candidates only after a maintainer-owned branch covers both required paths without the current readiness blockers.

recommendation.title: Select comprehensive branch after repair
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93216 as the canonical path if maintainers accept its exactly-once ownership shape and the draft/conflict/proof state is resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: piersonr authored the merged reply-payload hook composition work that created the current configured-beforeDeliver decision surface, so this is the strongest feature-history routing signal.
